series.name: Quattro / MultiPlus — front-panel LED alarm indication table (8-LED units)
series.notes: These rows are NOT numbered codes. The technician identifies them purely from the WHICH-LED-IS-LIT pattern on the 8-LED front panel (mains on / bulk / absorption / float / inverter on / overload / low battery / temperature). Sourced from the 120 V Quattro manual ch. 7.1 'General error indications'. The 230 V MultiPlus and MultiPlus-II/Quattro-II manuals carry the same table with the same LED patterns (identical wording, verified in both), so one series covers the pattern table across those units. Voltage figures differ: 95-140 VAC on the 120 V Quattro, 185-265 VAC on MultiPlus-II/Quattro-II 230 V, 187-250 VAC on MultiPlus 3k 230 V.

meaning.en: Battery voltage is low. The inverter is warning you it is about to shut down.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage kam hai. Inverter aap ko warn kar raha hai ke woh ab band hone wali hai.

causes.en: Battery bank discharged under load
causes.ur: Load ke under battery bank khatam ho gaya

causes.en: Poor or loose battery connection causing voltage drop
causes.ur: Battery connection kharab ya dheela jo voltage drop kar raha hai

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage with a multimeter under load, not at rest.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery voltage load ke under nikaalein, khali nahi.

solutions.en: Check and tighten the battery terminals; clean any corrosion with a wire brush.
solutions.ur: Battery terminals check karke tighten karein; wire brush se koi corrosion saaf karein.

solutions.en: Recharge the bank and confirm the charger is actually delivering current.
solutions.ur: Bank dobara charge karein aur check karein ke charger haqeeqat current de raha hai.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

title.en: Low battery LED lit - inverter cut out
title.ur: Low battery LED on - inverter band ho gaya

meaning.en: The unit has switched itself off because the battery voltage fell too low.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage bohat girne ki wajah se unit ne khud band kar diya hai.

causes.en: Battery voltage dropped below the cut-out threshold
causes.ur: Battery voltage cut-out threshold se neeche gir gaya

causes.en: Battery bank aged, sulfated or undersized for the load
causes.ur: Battery bank purana, sulfated ya load ke liye chhota hai

solutions.en: Disconnect AC and DC before working on the bank.
solutions.ur: Bank par kaam karne se pehle AC aur DC disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Charge the battery and check the battery connections.
solutions.ur: Battery charge karein aur battery connections check karein.

solutions.en: Load test each cell with a cell tester; replace cells below 75% of rated capacity.
solutions.ur: Har cell ko cell tester se load test karein; rated capacity se 75% se neeche cells badal dein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

meaning.en: The connected load is above the inverter's nominal rating; it is about to shut down.
meaning.ur: Connected load inverter ki nominal rating se upar hai; woh ab band hone wali hai.

causes.en: Load above the inverter's nominal VA/W rating
causes.ur: Load inverter ki nominal VA/W rating se upar hai

causes.en: Inrush current from motors or compressors at start-up
causes.ur: Motors ya compressors ka start-up inrush current

solutions.en: Measure actual load current with a clamp meter on AC-out.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se AC-out par actual load current nikaalein.

solutions.en: Reduce the load - switch off non-essential appliances first.
solutions.ur: Load kam karein - pehle ghair zaruri bartan band karein.

solutions.en: Stagger large appliance start-up so they do not all start together.
solutions.ur: Bhaari bartan ka start-up alag alag karein taake sab ek saath na chalein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

title.en: Overload LED lit - inverter cut out
title.ur: Overload LED on - inverter band ho gaya

meaning.en: The unit has switched itself off because the load was excessively high, or there is a short circuit.
meaning.ur: Load bohat zyada hone ya short circuit ki wajah se unit ne khud band kar diya hai.

causes.en: Excessively high load or a short circuit on the AC output
causes.ur: AC output par bohat zyada load ya short circuit

causes.en: Damaged appliance with a shorted winding
causes.ur: Kharaz bartan jis ki winding short ho gayi ho

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC before inspecting anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi dekhne se pehle AC aur DC disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect loads in halves to find the offending circuit; then test that appliance for a short.
solutions.ur: Loads aik aik aadhe hisse mein disconnect kar ke kharab circuit dhoondein; phir us bartan ko short ke liye test karein.

solutions.en: Replace the shorted appliance or cable - do not fit a bigger fuse to bypass it.
solutions.ur: Short hua bartan ya cable badal dein - is par badi fuse lagakar bypass na karein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

meaning.en: Internal temperature is at a critical level. The unit derates and then switches off.
meaning.ur: Internal temperature critical level par hai. Unit pehle power kam karta hai phir band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature too high in the installation room
causes.ur: Installation kamre mein ambient temperature bohat zyada hai

causes.en: Load too high causing internal heating
causes.ur: Load itna zyada ke unit khud garam ho raha hai

causes.en: Blocked or clogged cooling fan / poor airflow
causes.ur: Cooling fan band ya blocked, ya hawa ka aana kam hai

solutions.en: Install the unit in a cool, well-ventilated place; leave 10 cm clear around it.
solutions.ur: Unit ko thande aur hawa wala jagah lagayein; charon taraf 10 cm khali rakhein.

solutions.en: Blow dust out of the fan and vents with dry compressed air.
solutions.ur: Fan aur vents ko dry compressed air se dhool saaf karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load, then reset the unit by switching it off and on.
solutions.ur: Connected load kam karein, phir unit ko off karke on karke reset karein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

aliases: Low battery and overload LEDs flash intermittently

title.ur: Low battery aur overload baari baari flash kar rahe hain

meaning.en: Low battery voltage combined with an excessively high load. The unit is fighting both conditions at once.
meaning.ur: Low battery voltage aur bohat zyada load aik saath. Unit dono conditions se lad raha hai.

causes.en: Battery voltage too low for the load being drawn
causes.ur: Liye ja rahe load ke liye battery voltage bohat kam hai

causes.en: Load too high for the remaining battery capacity
causes.ur: Bachi hui battery capacity ke liye load bohat zyada hai

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage and load current together with a clamp meter.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter ke saath battery voltage aur load current aik saath nikaalein.

solutions.en: Charge the batteries, or disconnect / reduce the load.
solutions.ur: Batteries charge karein, ya load disconnect karke kam karein.

solutions.en: Install higher capacity batteries, and fit shorter and/or thicker battery cables.
solutions.ur: Bade capacity ki batteries lagayein, aur battery cables chhoti aur/or moti lagayein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

aliases: Low battery and overload LEDs flash simultaneously

title.en: Low batt + overload flashing together (DC ripple)
title.ur: Low battery aur overload saath flash (DC ripple)

meaning.en: Ripple voltage on the DC connection exceeds 1.5 Vrms. The battery cable run is too thin, too long, or the connections are resistive.
meaning.ur: DC connection par ripple voltage 1.5 Vrms se zyada hai. Battery cable bahut patli ya lambi hai, ya connections mein resistance hai.

causes.en: Battery cable too thin or too long for the current
causes.ur: Battery cable current ke liye bahut patli ya lambi hai

causes.en: Corroded or loose battery connections adding resistance
causes.ur: Corrode ya dheele battery connections jo resistance barha rahe hain

solutions.en: Check the battery cables and battery connections; clean and re-tighten every terminal.
solutions.ur: Battery cables aur connections check karein; har terminal saaf karke dobara tighten karein.

solutions.en: Measure DC ripple with the unit off load using a true RMS meter; expect under 1.5 Vrms.
solutions.ur: Unit load ke baghair true RMS meter se DC ripple nikaalein; 1.5 Vrms se kam hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Check whether battery capacity is high enough, and increase it if not.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery capacity kaafi hai ya nahi, aur zaroorat ho to barha dein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

aliases: Low battery and overload LEDs light

title.en: Low batt + overload lit - cut out on DC ripple
title.ur: Low battery aur overload on - DC ripple par band

meaning.en: The inverter has switched off because the ripple voltage on the DC input was excessively high.
meaning.ur: DC input par ripple voltage bohat zyada hone ki wajah se inverter band ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Excessively high ripple voltage on the battery input
causes.ur: Battery input par bohat zyada ripple voltage

causes.en: Undersized or over-long battery cables
causes.ur: Battery cables chhoti ya bohat lambi

solutions.en: Install batteries with a larger capacity.
solutions.ur: Bade capacity ki batteries lagayein.

solutions.en: Fit shorter and/or thicker battery cables.
solutions.ur: Chhoti aur/or moti battery cables lagayein.

solutions.en: Reset the inverter by switching it off and then on again.
solutions.ur: Inverter ko off karke phir on karke reset karein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

aliases: One alarm LED lights and the second flashes

title.en: One LED lit + one flashing (imminent shutdown)
title.ur: Aik LED on + aik flash (band hone wali hai)

meaning.en: The unit has already switched off. The lit LED names the alarm that tripped it; the flashing LED shows it was about to switch off for that reason.
meaning.ur: Unit pehle hi band ho chuka hai. Jo LED on hai woh alarm bata raha hai; jo flash kar raha hai woh batata hai ke usi wajah se band hone wala tha.

causes.en: Low battery, overload or over-temperature alarm tripped
causes.ur: Low battery, overload ya zyada temperature ka alarm trigger hua

causes.en: Load step or charging fault coinciding with the alarm
causes.ur: Load step ya charging fault alarm ke saath a gaya

solutions.en: Read which LED is steady-lit and look up that row in this table.
solutions.ur: Dekhein kaun sa LED steady on hai aur usi row ko is table mein dekhein.

solutions.en: Fix the cause in the matching row before resetting the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit reset karne se pehle usi row ki wajah theek karein.

solutions.en: Reset by switching the front On/Off/Charger-only rocker off and on.
solutions.ur: Front ke On/Off/Charger-only rocker ko off karke on karke reset karein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

meaning.en: Several distinct causes: AC input out of range, the AC-in breaker or fuse open, the battery fuse blown, or heavy AC distortion (typically a generator).
meaning.ur: Kai alag wajuhat: AC input range se bahar, AC-in breaker ya fuse khula hua, battery fuse ula hua, ya AC distortion zyada (aksar generator).

causes.en: AC input voltage or frequency outside the configured range
causes.ur: AC input voltage ya frequency configured range se bahar

causes.en: Circuit breaker or fuse in the AC-in input open after an overload
causes.ur: AC-in input ka circuit breaker ya fuse overload ke baad khul gaya

causes.en: Battery fuse has blown
causes.ur: Battery fuse ula hua hai

causes.en: AC input distortion or voltage too large, generally from a generator
causes.ur: AC input distortion ya voltage bohat zyada, aam tor par generator se

solutions.en: On 120 V Quattro confirm AC-in is 95-140 VAC and 45-65 Hz; on 230 V units use 185-265 VAC.
solutions.ur: 120 V Quattro par AC-in 95-140 VAC aur 45-65 Hz check karein; 230 V units par 185-265 VAC dekhein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, then check the AC-in breaker and the DC battery fuse with a continuity tester.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC disconnect karke AC-in breaker aur DC battery fuse continuity tester se check karein.

solutions.en: Remove any overload or short on AC-out-1 or AC-out-2, then reset the fuse or breaker.
solutions.ur: AC-out-1 ya AC-out-2 par overload ya short hata dein, phir fuse ya breaker reset karein.

solutions.en: Replace the battery fuse with the exact type and rating from the manual - never a bigger one.
solutions.ur: Battery fuse manual wali exact type aur rating se badal dein - kabhi badi nahi.

solutions.en: If the supply is a generator, switch on 'Weak AC' and the dynamic current limiter in VEConfigure.
solutions.ur: Agar supply generator hai to VEConfigure mein 'Weak AC' aur dynamic current limiter on karein.
